summary: Removed the injected artificial action-budget number from both agent-facing surfaces: runner.py _bootstrap_zonoid_requirements_task summary and adapter.py _agent_prompt no longer state 'action budget (<max_steps>)' / 'Max steps: N'; both now instruct the agent to DISCOVER the game's own action/resource budget from its signals and not assume any externally supplied step count is the real budget. ARC_MAX_ACTIONS remains a non-exposed safety ceiling. Fixes the 200-step run finding where the agent recalled '200 task-actions' and dismissed the real in-game 11-bar budget, defeating cost-awareness. Verified: py_compile both files, no literal budget number remains in prompt/summary text, --dry-run ok. Committed 7015c7ed.
